mentions.name: Crypto, Fiat, AI Ecosystem
mentions.description: A financial infrastructure platform combining crypto, fiat, and AI to make managing money in decentralized environments simpler and smarter. It moves beyond the traditional wallet model, using real-time intelligence and automation to help people make better financial decisions, with a focus on streamlining DeFi, improving transparency, and reducing user fatigue while fitting into daily financial life.
mentions.problem: Managing money across crypto and fiat in decentralized environments is complex, with limited transparency and user fatigue from the traditional wallet model.
mentions.audience: everyday users, especially in emerging markets, not just crypto-native folks
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a new kind of financial infrastructure that combines crypto, fiat, and AI to make managing money in decentralized environments simpler and smarter. The core idea is to move beyond the traditional 'wallet' model and instead help people, especially in emerging markets, make better, more informed financial decisions using real-time intelligence and automation.
